question: Which of the following places is associated with National Waterways Number 2?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dhubri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The sadiya-Dhubri** stretch of the **Brahmaputra river** is declared as the **National Waterways 2** by the **National Waterway act 1988**.
 
• The waterway **extends** for a distance of **891 km** from** Dhubri to Sadiya**.
